server_url.description:
The BlueBubbles server on your Mac, for example `http://192.168.1.20:1234`. Its password
comes from `config.json` or `MESSAGES_SERVER_PASSWORD`.

notifications.description: Show a notification for messages that arrive while Messages is in the background.

tray.description: Keep an item in the menu bar or tray with the unread count.

demo.description: Run on the built-in fixtures instead of a server.

agent_url.description:
The Mac agent for Find My and shared pins, for example `http://192.168.1.20:1236`. Its
token comes from `config.json` or `MESSAGES_AGENT_TOKEN`.

assistant_model.description:
CanaryLLM model for summaries, translations and transcripts, as `provider/model`. Empty
uses the default.

translate_to.description: Language translations go into. Empty follows the system language.
